notes.text: P1示例写100 Kb/s、100% reliability；是需求示例而非实际保证。图29的10 Mb/s、100%未完整注明100%指标或测量周期，不补填。
CF1的Reliability写99.95，未印百分号；其他行有%。保留99.95原样并标疑点。表中N/A具体表示不适用还是未提供并不明确，不当作0。预算币种及分配公式未给。
Week5可靠性列用百分比，Week4可靠性用MTBF/MTBCF等时间指标。资料没有转换规则，不跨语义合并为同一定义。
图4.36的两部分/多部分类型写Stochastic，正文和TXT用predictable。资料未定义两者关系，分开记录，不当作已证明的同义词。
正文说predictable capacities, delays and RMA are added，但图/标签指定容量求和、Dp minimum、Rp maximum，TXT强调最严格相关要求；不能把时延也算术相加。未给RMA不同指标统一排序的模型。Ri在TXT称reliability，邻页Rp称RMA，保留措辞差异。
‘Currently the most generally applicable model’仅为课件叙述。本材料的client-server模型强调服务器到客户机主流，教师补充源/汇随请求与响应改变，不推广为所有应用的固定方向。
只使用指定PDF/TXT。参考书及章节未另行查阅；未出现可执行代码，算法按课件图、符号与录音整理。
TXT先称个人essay为assessment 2，稍后看平台时改称assessment 3；编号冲突待核实。录音中的截止日期、密码及测验安排仅作为历史材料，不视作当前要求。

legacyEntries.en: Characterising traffic flows, their likely locations, and their performance needs. Focus on those with the greatest impact, not every possible flow.
legacyEntries.zh: 流分析；描述流量、可能位置和所需性能，只重点研究影响最大的流，不画所有可能流。

legacyEntries.en: A set of network traffic with common attributes. It may carry application, protocol, or control information.
legacyEntries.zh: 流／流量／数据流；具有共同属性的一组网络流量，可含应用、协议或控制信息。

legacyEntries.en: A map used as the basis for locating flows after requirements have been identified.
legacyEntries.zh: 需求地图；已有需求确定后，用来判断流量可能在哪些位置通过。

legacyEntries.en: A flow considered across its source and destination, with requirements and location information together.
legacyEntries.zh: 端到端实体；把性能需求与位置结合，看整个源到目的过程。

legacyEntries.en: Three kinds of traffic named in the slide. Detailed protocol and control formats are not defined.
legacyEntries.term: Application information / protocol information / control information
legacyEntries.zh: 应用信息／协议信息／控制信息；课件仅列类别，不定义报文结构。

legacyEntries.en: Shared features used to group traffic into a flow, such as addresses, information type, and directionality.
legacyEntries.zh: 共同属性；例如源／目的地址、信息类型及方向。

legacyEntries.en: Endpoint addresses, port labels, and the kind of information; shown as flow attributes in Figure 4.1.
legacyEntries.term: Source/destination addresses / port numbers / information type
legacyEntries.zh: 图4.1中的端点地址、端口编号、信息类型；课件未定义地址或端口的技术机制。

legacyEntries.en: Labels for the route through the network and QoS settings. QoS is not expanded or formally defined here.
legacyEntries.zh: 图4.1标签：网络内路由／QoS参数；未展开QoS缩写或给正式定义。

legacyEntries.en: Performance labels in Figure 4.2. The parentheses give examples; the figure does not prove that each pair is identical.
legacyEntries.term: Capacity (e.g., Bandwidth) / Delay (e.g., Latency) / Reliability (e.g., Availability)
legacyEntries.zh: 图4.2性能标签：容量（如带宽）、时延（如latency）、可靠性（如可用性）；括号例子不应当作严格同义定义。

legacyEntries.en: A performance category in the flow-characteristics table; no service classes or guarantees are defined here.
legacyEntries.zh: 服务质量等级；表中列名，未定义具体等级或保证。

legacyEntries.en: Importance labels in the table, based on business, enterprise, provider, or political concerns.
legacyEntries.zh: 图4.2重要性／优先级标签：业务、企业、提供方、政治因素；没有给固定排名公式。

legacyEntries.en: Shared users, applications, or devices / when traffic is scheduled, such as its time of day.
legacyEntries.term: Common sets of users, applications, devices / Scheduling (e.g., Time-of-Day)
legacyEntries.zh: 图4.2其他属性：共同用户／应用／设备集合、调度（如一天中的时段）。

legacyEntries.en: Table labels for protocols, endpoint details, and security or privacy needs. Their technical mechanisms are not defined.
legacyEntries.zh: 图4.2标签：所用协议、地址／端口、安全／隐私要求；未解释技术机制。

legacyEntries.en: A flow for one session of one application. It is a basic unit and may be combined; a guaranteed requirement must stay with that flow.
legacyEntries.zh: 个体流；某应用单次会话的基本流单位，可合并分析，但保证需求必须仍归该个体流。

legacyEntries.en: The example individual flow has a guaranteed peak capacity of 15 Mb/s. Keep its guarantee explicit.
legacyEntries.zh: 保证容量；图4.4示例要求15 Mb/s峰值保证，不能隐藏在平均值中。

legacyEntries.en: Combined requirements of several applications or individual flows that share a link, path, or network.
legacyEntries.zh: 复合流；多应用／个体流因共享链路、路径或网络而组合需求。

legacyEntries.en: The shared part that allows several flows to be treated together.
legacyEntries.term: Common link / common path / common network
legacyEntries.zh: 公共链路／路径／网络；构成复合流的共同部分。

legacyEntries.en: A flow treated as more important because of performance, strict requirements, or important users, applications, or devices.

sources.anchor: Critical does not always mean high capacity

legacyEntries.zh: 关键流；因性能、严格要求或重要使用者等而优先；教师强调不必是容量最大的流。

legacyEntries.en: Direction labels for traffic toward one side, traffic toward the other side, and traffic in both directions. Define the viewpoint.
legacyEntries.zh: 上行／下行／双向；要说明相对哪个端点。示例不同方向可有不同速率。

legacyEntries.en: Delay in one direction / delay for an outward and return trip. RT is used as a round-trip label in the diagram.
legacyEntries.zh: 单向时延／往返时延；图11、12示例100ms，不能互换为同一指标。

legacyEntries.en: An availability requirement in the composite-flow example; the figure gives no measurement period or maintenance rule.
legacyEntries.zh: 复合流示例的100%可用时间要求；图未给周期或维护规则，不能假定无条件保证。

legacyEntries.en: A reusable performance description referred to by name instead of writing every value beside a flow.
legacyEntries.zh: 性能配置描述1；图12示例用profile名称引用性能要求，具体值该图未给。

legacyEntries.en: Use the requirements specification, behaviour, locations, and performance needs to find and describe important flows.
legacyEntries.zh: 识别与建立流；依据需求规格、行为、位置及性能需要。

legacyEntries.en: The input record of user, application, device, network, behaviour, location, and performance requirements.
legacyEntries.zh: 需求规格说明；本讲把它当流识别的输入，不替代原需求记录。

legacyEntries.en: Start sending traffic / be the endpoint where that traffic is received.
legacyEntries.zh: 产生／终止流量；用于确认相关应用或设备。

legacyEntries.en: An application view / a set of applications / a task such as video conferencing or storage.
legacyEntries.zh: 应用视角／应用组／功能；可选作流分析的关注对象。

legacyEntries.en: A shared description for flows with common performance needs. Keep its definition clear when reusing it.
legacyEntries.zh: 性能profile／建立profile；共用需求描述，便于复用，必须保留明确值。

legacyEntries.en: In the example, a profile for six flows with capacity 100 Kb/s and reliability 100%. This is an example requirement, not a universal profile.
legacyEntries.zh: 示例P1：六条流共用100 Kb/s容量、100%可靠性需求；不代表所有流都取此值，也不证明实际能达成。

legacyEntries.en: Select N important applications, for example 3, 5, or 10. Criteria include usage, user/device/server counts, or performance needs.
legacyEntries.zh: 前N个应用；N可为3、5、10等示例，并非固定。按使用程度、用户／设备／服务器数或性能需求选择。

legacyEntries.en: Applications left out of the selected set. Check whether their requirements will still be met.
legacyEntries.zh: 被筛除的应用；仍须检查设计是否满足它们的需求，不能自动忽略。

legacyEntries.en: Identify flows and their requirements and locations; locate sources and sinks; apply models where needed; combine requirements into flowspecs.
legacyEntries.zh: 流识别过程：识别流／需求／位置→定位源和汇→按需用模型→汇成流规格。

legacyEntries.en: Selection measures describing how much an application is used and how many users or systems it involves.
legacyEntries.term: Degree of usage / number of users, devices, servers
legacyEntries.zh: 使用程度／用户、设备、服务器数量；Top N选择依据。

legacyEntries.en: Locate the important application's devices, then add estimated traffic between them.
legacyEntries.term: Application-driven map / flows estimated between devices
legacyEntries.zh: 应用驱动位置图／设备间估计流；先定位组件，再加箭头表示流量。

legacyEntries.en: A device or endpoint that generates a flow.
legacyEntries.zh: 数据源；产生流量的设备或端点。

legacyEntries.en: A device or endpoint that terminates a flow by receiving its data.
legacyEntries.zh: 数据汇／接收端；不是日常sink“水槽”。

legacyEntries.en: Almost all devices can be both sources and sinks. The role depends on the flow direction.
legacyEntries.zh: 源和汇角色；几乎所有设备可同时具备两种角色，取决于具体流。

legacyEntries.en: The diagrams use a dot-in-circle for a source and a star-like mark in a circle for a sink.
legacyEntries.zh: 源／汇符号；图24、28用圆点及星形标记区分方向，可在同一设备显示两者。

legacyEntries.en: A server that provides application data / the data it sends. The source example labels these together.
legacyEntries.zh: 应用服务器／应用数据；数据源图中的对应标签。

legacyEntries.en: Named examples of data sources that compute, process, or produce much data. The lecture does not define their architectures.

legacyEntries.en: Devices for particular tasks, including cameras, video-production equipment, and medical instruments.

legacyEntries.en: A video source / instrument data named in the source figure. Telemetry is not formally defined in this lecture.
legacyEntries.zh: 视频设备／遥测及控制数据；图26标签，未正式定义遥测。

legacyEntries.en: Devices that store data or keep it for later use; typical sinks.

legacyEntries.en: Sink-example labels: storing, editing, showing, or using incoming data.
legacyEntries.term: Storage device / video editing / video display / user device
legacyEntries.zh: 图27数据汇标签：存储设备、视频编辑、视频显示、用户设备。

legacyEntries.en: A label in the data-sink figure. The lecture does not expand or define it.
legacyEntries.zh: 图27中的VoIP标签；资料未展开缩写或定义，不自行补充。

legacyEntries.en: An application moving data between locations; the maps show different source/sink roles for parts of the transfer.
legacyEntries.zh: 数据迁移应用；图28、29展示不同传送阶段的源／汇，未给详细迁移流程。

legacyEntries.en: Flows between servers / local flow labels in the maps. Figure 4.20 isolates F4 with 10 Mb/s and 100% beside it.
legacyEntries.term: Server-server flow / F4 / F5 / F6 / F7
legacyEntries.zh: 服务器间流／F4–F7；仅示例编号。图29独立显示F4，旁标10 Mb/s、100%，后者具体指标口径未注明。

legacyEntries.en: Campus-map labels for storage systems, computing systems, and video equipment.
legacyEntries.term: Storage server / storage servers / compute servers / digital video
legacyEntries.zh: 校园图中的存储服务器、计算服务器、数字视频标签；数量括号及位置属于示例。

legacyEntries.en: The three locations used in the campus-flow example.
legacyEntries.term: Central Campus / North Campus / South Campus
legacyEntries.zh: 中央／北／南校园；示例地点名，不是通用网络类型。

legacyEntries.en: A group of flows with specific, consistent behaviour characteristics.
legacyEntries.zh: 流模型；具备特定且一致行为特征的一组流。

legacyEntries.en: A flow's tendency to have more requirements in one direction. Source and sink roles help show it.
legacyEntries.zh: 方向性；某一方向需求较多的倾向，由源／汇帮助判断。

legacyEntries.en: Levels and connections used to see where flows combine, form groups, or pass between peers.
legacyEntries.zh: 层级／互连关系；用于分析流在哪汇合、成组或在同层设备间传送。

legacyEntries.en: Flows between devices at the same hierarchy level / those devices.
legacyEntries.zh: 对等流／对等节点；同一层级设备之间的流。

legacyEntries.en: Users and applications act at the same level and have similar flow behaviour. If flows cannot be distinguished, all or none are treated as critical.
legacyEntries.zh: 对等流模型；同层行为相近，若不能区分重要性则全为关键或全非关键，不是对所有真实P2P流的绝对定律。

legacyEntries.en: Flows treated alike and described by one shared specification or profile. Use the peer model when no other flow information is available.
legacyEntries.term: Equivalent flows / single specification or profile
legacyEntries.zh: 等效流／单一规格或profile；缺乏其他信息时课件建议可用peer模型。

legacyEntries.en: Examples of the peer-to-peer flow model in this lecture.
legacyEntries.zh: 早期互联网／文件共享系统；本讲P2P例子，不扩展为历史论断。

legacyEntries.en: Protocol names shown in the early-Internet peer example; their full definitions are not supplied.
legacyEntries.zh: 早期互联网图中的协议名；资料未展开全称或定义，不增补机制。

legacyEntries.en: A model with hierarchy and directionality. The slide emphasises asymmetric flows toward clients, with servers as main sources.
legacyEntries.zh: 客户机—服务器流模型；课件重点是服务器到客户机的非对称主流。

legacyEntries.en: Flows whose two directions have different traffic or performance needs.
legacyEntries.zh: 非对称流；两个方向的流量或需求不同，不能只数请求。

legacyEntries.en: Traffic asking a server for something / traffic sent back by the server.
legacyEntries.zh: 请求／响应；请求与响应对应不同方向，客户机发请求时也是源。

legacyEntries.en: The main flows; in the lecture's client-server example these come from servers and are treated as critical.
legacyEntries.zh: 主导流；本讲客户机—服务器例子中来自服务器，是关键流。需结合实际应用。

legacyEntries.en: Online business / applications accessed through the web; examples of client-server flows.
legacyEntries.zh: 电子商务／Web应用；客户机—服务器模型例子，基础词义。

legacyEntries.en: Figure labels for serving video, storing it, editing it, and asking for a file.
legacyEntries.term: Video server / video storage / video editing station / request video file
legacyEntries.zh: 图37标签：视频服务器、视频存储、视频编辑站、请求视频文件；响应是Video File。

legacyEntries.en: A client-server model with extra layers between servers and flows to support servers. A server can be a source, sink, or both.
legacyEntries.zh: 分层客户机—服务器流模型；增加服务器层和支撑服务器间流，服务器可为源、汇或两者。

legacyEntries.en: Levels in the model / extra servers that support other servers.
legacyEntries.zh: 层／层级／支撑服务器；分层模型增加这些关系。

legacyEntries.en: An application that manages multiple client-server applications; one sign that a hierarchical model may fit.
legacyEntries.zh: 高层应用；可管理多个客户机—服务器应用，是分层模型适用提示之一。

legacyEntries.en: The top server or controller / servers closer to clients in the hierarchy figure. The figure gives no control protocol.
legacyEntries.zh: 全局服务器／控制器、局部服务器；图39的层级角色，未定义控制协议。

legacyEntries.en: They depend on application behaviour. Client-server flows may be the only critical ones; server-server flows may also be critical.
legacyEntries.term: Critical flows in a hierarchical model
legacyEntries.zh: 分层模型关键流依赖应用行为；可能只有客户机—服务器流关键，也可能服务器间流同样关键。

legacyEntries.en: Shared databases, information exchange, and making server copies; examples where server-server traffic can matter.
legacyEntries.term: Common databases / sharing information / replication of web servers
legacyEntries.zh: 共享数据库／共享信息／Web服务器复制；服务器间流可能关键的情形。

legacyEntries.en: A named hierarchical-flow example. The lecture gives no detailed simulation design.
legacyEntries.zh: 科学可视化仿真；列为分层模型例子，未进一步定义设计。

legacyEntries.en: Labels in the web-service hierarchy. Mirror indicates copied content in the teacher's explanation; CDN is not expanded or defined.
legacyEntries.term: Regional server / web client / CDN / mirror
legacyEntries.zh: 图41区域服务器／Web客户机／CDN／镜像；教师提到镜像内容，CDN未展开或定义。

legacyEntries.en: A model that can be the inverse of client-server or a hybrid of peer-to-peer and client-server behaviour.
legacyEntries.zh: 分布式计算流模型；可以呈客户机—服务器反向特征，也可混合P2P与客户机—服务器特征。

legacyEntries.en: A manager assigning computing work / the server shown in the figure / a device doing part of the work.
legacyEntries.term: Task manager / task server / computing node
legacyEntries.zh: 任务管理者／任务服务器／计算节点；图42任务服务器可能为汇，计算节点可为源和汇。

legacyEntries.en: Communication between computing nodes, not only their connections to the task server.
legacyEntries.zh: 计算节点间交互；图42标Interaction，教师强调也需分析节点间通信。

legacyEntries.en: Strong dependence between devices / weaker dependence. The slide links them to peer-to-peer / client-server flows respectively.
legacyEntries.zh: 紧密耦合／松散耦合；课件分别关联P2P流／客户机—服务器流，后者可能形成集群。

legacyEntries.en: How work is divided among computing devices.
legacyEntries.zh: 任务粒度；描述任务如何划分给设备。

legacyEntries.en: Each task is assigned to one computing device.
legacyEntries.zh: 粗粒度；每个任务分配给一个计算设备。

legacyEntries.en: A task is divided between several devices.
legacyEntries.zh: 细粒度；一个任务分给多个设备共同处理。

legacyEntries.en: Requirements with little room for change / stopping while waiting for information from other devices.
legacyEntries.term: Inflexible requirements / waiting for neighbour devices
legacyEntries.zh: 不易放宽的需求／等待相邻设备；分布式模型可能要求最严格，节点等信息时可能停止工作，并非所有模型都必然如此。

legacyEntries.en: Rank flows by importance to decide which get resources first.
legacyEntries.zh: 流优先级排序；决定哪些流先获得资源。

legacyEntries.en: Business impact, political aims, performance, security, or number of users, applications, and devices served.
legacyEntries.zh: 排序准则；业务目标／影响、政治目标、性能、安全、服务用户／应用／设备数均可作为依据。

legacyEntries.en: Flow identifiers in the example table. F labels individual flows; CF labels composite flows in the teacher's explanation.
legacyEntries.term: FlowID / F1 / F2 / F3 / CF1 / CF2 / CF3
legacyEntries.zh: 流标识；示例F1–F3为个体流，CF1–CF3为复合流，不能把编号当成协议名。

legacyEntries.en: The table's three performance columns. Reliability is shown as a percentage, unlike Week4's time-between-failure measures; no conversion rule is supplied.
legacyEntries.zh: 性能表三列：可靠性、容量、时延。本表可靠性用百分比，Week4用故障间隔指标；资料未提供转换规则，不混为同一定义。

legacyEntries.en: Table columns for the users served, money assigned, and relative rank.
legacyEntries.zh: 用户数／预算／优先级；示例数值与选择准则相关，不代表唯一分配方法。

legacyEntries.en: The example ranks CF2, CF1, F1, F2, F3, then CF3 as user counts fall from 2100 to 50.
CF1 is first; F2 and F3 share second place; F1, CF2, and CF3 share third because no reliability value is stated.
legacyEntries.zh: 按可靠性排序；CF1第一，F2/F3并列第二，未列可靠性值的三条流并列第三。CF1原值99.95缺百分号，需核实。

legacyEntries.en: A marker for a value not available or not applicable. The table does not state which meaning each cell has; it is not zero.
legacyEntries.zh: 不适用／未提供；表格各格具体含义不明，不能当作0或自行猜值。

legacyEntries.en: Data-rate and delay units, and money in thousands. The slide varies the case of K; the budgets do not name a currency.
legacyEntries.zh: 兆比特每秒／千比特每秒／毫秒／千元；K/k大小写不一致，预算未注明币种，不推算字节率。

legacyEntries.en: A combined record describing flows and their requirements, including best-effort, predictable, and guaranteed categories.
legacyEntries.zh: 流规格说明；汇总识别／定义／描述结果，列流及其要求，区分尽力而为、可预测、保证类别。

legacyEntries.en: Bring together performance needs for flows sharing a resource or for all flows in a section.
legacyEntries.term: Combine requirements for composite flows / a network section
legacyEntries.zh: 合并复合流／网络区段需求；允许区段汇总，但不能隐去个体保证条件。

legacyEntries.en: In the lecture's flowspec calculation, these contribute only capacity requirements. The material does not define a full service contract.
legacyEntries.zh: 尽力而为流；本讲算法仅使用其容量需求，不补充完整服务契约。

legacyEntries.en: A service category whose available performance requirements are combined. Full formal service semantics are not defined here.
legacyEntries.zh: 可预测流；合并已有性能要求，未给完整正式服务语义。

legacyEntries.en: Requirements that must remain individually listed for each guaranteed flow.
legacyEntries.zh: 保证流／保证需求；每条流各项需求必须单独保留，不能改为平均值。

legacyEntries.en: A specification in which all flows are best effort. Combine capacities only.
legacyEntries.zh: 单部分流规格；所有流为best effort，仅合并容量。

legacyEntries.en: A specification containing predictable flows; it may also contain best-effort flows.
legacyEntries.zh: 两部分流规格；含predictable，可含best effort，但不是必须有两种流。

legacyEntries.en: A specification containing guaranteed flows; it may also contain predictable and best-effort flows.
legacyEntries.zh: 多部分流规格；含guaranteed，可同时含另两种流，不要求三类全有。

legacyEntries.en: A word used in Figure 4.36 for the two-part and multi-part flow types. The supplied material does not define it or establish that it means predictable.
legacyEntries.zh: 随机性；必要基础词义。图4.36使用此词而正文用predictable，资料未明确两者关系，不直接合并同义。

legacyEntries.en: A mechanism for combining requirements to obtain optimal composite performance, using different rules for the three service categories.
legacyEntries.zh: 流规格算法；按三种类别的不同规则合并性能需求。资料没有给完整实现代码或证明。

legacyEntries.en: The capacity needed for a best-effort flow; Σ CBE represents their combined capacity.
legacyEntries.zh: 尽力而为容量；图54的CBE及其求和。

legacyEntries.en: Add the listed values / add best-effort flow capacities in the lecture's calculation.
legacyEntries.zh: 求和符号／best-effort容量之和；只按本讲容量合并规则，不加入未给的额外统计假设。

legacyEntries.en: The capacity required for predictable flows / the combined predictable capacities.
legacyEntries.zh: 可预测容量／可预测容量求和；与best effort的Σ CBE分部分表示。

legacyEntries.en: The minimum delay requirement used to protect the strictest predictable delay target.
legacyEntries.zh: 可预测时延要求；取最小的要求值，而非把所有时延相加或取宽松平均。

legacyEntries.en: The maximum predictable RMA requirement shown on the slide. How all RMA measures are converted to one ordered scale is not defined.
legacyEntries.zh: 可预测RMA要求；课件标maximum，未说明如何把MTTR等不同方向／单位的RMA指标统一排序，不扩展为所有指标取数值最大。

legacyEntries.en: The individual guaranteed flow's capacity, reliability/RMA, and delay requirements, kept separately in a multi-part specification.
legacyEntries.zh: 保证流i的容量、可靠性／RMA、时延；各条分别保留。TXT称Ri为reliability，邻页用RMA，记为来源用语差异。

legacyEntries.en: Combine the capacities of best-effort flows as Σ CBE.
legacyEntries.zh: 单部分计算：best-effort容量求和。

legacyEntries.en: Keep Σ CBE; combine predictable capacities as Σ Cp subject to Dp minimum and Rp maximum. Do not simply add delays or average requirements.
legacyEntries.zh: 两部分计算：保留Σ CBE，再有Σ Cp及Dp最小、Rp最大约束。正文added不能理解成所有指标算术相加。

legacyEntries.en: Use the two-part structure and add each guaranteed requirement separately as Ci, Ri, Di.
legacyEntries.zh: 多部分计算：沿两部分结构再加入逐条Ci/Ri/Di保证条件。

legacyEntries.en: As a starting foundation / expected to happen / the largest effect.
legacyEntries.term: as the basis for / likely to occur / greatest impact
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 作为依据／可能出现／最大影响；flow analysis只重点覆盖高影响流。

legacyEntries.en: Groups of / shared features / linked to.
legacyEntries.term: sets of / common attributes / associated with
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 若干集合／共同属性／与……关联；set并不意味着只有一条包。

legacyEntries.en: The smallest working unit here / stay attached to that exact flow.
legacyEntries.term: basic unit / remain with THAT flow
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 基本单位／仍归该条特定流；THAT强调不能转移或隐藏个体保证。

legacyEntries.en: A shared feature / requirements with little room to relax / decide relative importance.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 共同点／严格要求／确定优先顺序。

legacyEntries.en: Viewed through applications / give attention to.
legacyEntries.term: from an application perspective / focus on
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 从应用视角／关注；可选应用、应用组、设备或功能。

legacyEntries.en: Having a strong influence on architecture and design choices.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 推动／决定架构和设计方向；driving这里不是驾驶。

legacyEntries.en: When useful or necessary / standards for choice / left out / be satisfied.
legacyEntries.term: where needed / criteria / eliminated / be met
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 按需／准则／被筛除／得到满足；Top N不免除其他应用需求。

legacyEntries.en: Nearly all, but not every one / common examples / made for a particular purpose.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 几乎全部／典型的／专用的；保留almost，不能改成所有。

legacyEntries.en: For long-term keeping / process or change / show / be the receiving endpoint here.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 归档的／处理或操作／显示／终止；terminate此处是流终点，不是删除数据。

legacyEntries.en: Show / particular behaviour that follows a similar pattern.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 表现出／特定且一致的行为。

legacyEntries.en: A tendency toward one choice / at equal rank / across the whole area.
legacyEntries.term: preference / at the same level / throughout
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 倾向／同层级／遍及；directionality不只是画箭头。

legacyEntries.en: Cannot tell meaningful differences / treated as alike / mostly following the same pattern.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 无法区分／等效／相当一致；不是每个数值必须完全相等。

legacyEntries.en: Useful in many cases / unequal across directions / mainly directed toward.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 普遍适用／非对称／主要朝向；“currently”是课件说法，不当作已验证现状。

legacyEntries.en: Main or strongest / as a result / has the role of.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 主导的／因此／充当；source/sink为具体流的角色。

legacyEntries.en: Complete work / controlled or coordinated by / determined by.
legacyEntries.term: accomplish a task / managed by / dependent upon
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 完成任务／由……管理／取决于。

legacyEntries.en: As part of its nature / serving several sessions / making copies.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 内在地／支持多个会话／复制。

legacyEntries.en: Opposite-direction features / a mix of types / differences used to classify.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 反向特征／混合／分类差异。

legacyEntries.en: Given to do / split among / difficult to change or relax.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 分配给／细分给多个对象／难以放宽。

legacyEntries.en: Putting in order / aims / receiving available resources before other flows.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 排序／目标／先获得资源。

legacyEntries.en: At least one / supported by a flow / using importance as the basis.
legacyEntries.term: one or more / served by a flow / based upon importance
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 一个或多个／由流服务的／依据重要性。

legacyEntries.en: A written description of requirements / records as entries / one part of the network.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 规格说明／列出／网络区段。

legacyEntries.en: Can include, but need not / every included flow is / retain each separately.
legacyEntries.term: may contain / all flows are / keep them individual
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 可包含而非必须包含／所有流都是／各自保留；三类flowspec的条件必须保留。

legacyEntries.en: A method / the best combined performance aimed for / make as strong as required.
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 机制／最优组合性能目标／最大化；未给通用最优证明。

legacyEntries.en: Every requirement supplied / each performance aspect / under these constraints.
legacyEntries.term: all available requirements / each characteristic / subject to
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 所有已有要求／每类特征／受……约束；不同指标使用不同合并规则。

legacyEntries.en: Do not replace stricter requirements with an easier average.

sources.anchor: not just calculating a relaxed average

legacyEntries.term: not just calculating a relaxed average
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 不能只算较宽松的平均值；教师说明predictable合并要保护最严格相关要求。

legacyEntries.en: Needs missed by the analysis / a value that can change with project goals.
legacyEntries.term: blind spots / not a permanent property
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 分析盲点／不是固定属性；教师强调筛选不能遗漏需求，优先级随项目目标变。

legacyEntries.en: One selection rule / easy to see and understand / missing facts / invent a value.
legacyEntries.term: criterion / transparent / incomplete information / make up a number
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 单个准则／透明易懂／信息不完整／编造数值；criterion单数，criteria复数。

legacyEntries.en: Be physically present / registered for / see the quiz entry before starting / questions with answer options.
legacyEntries.term: attend in person / enrolled in / preview quiz / multiple-choice questions
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 到现场／已注册在／预览测验／选择题；仅释录音通知语言，不当当前安排。

legacyEntries.en: Work by one person / group work / must be submitted by / final time / a short warning in advance.
legacyEntries.term: individual work / teamwork / due / deadline / just a heads up
legacyEntries.topic: 阅读所需普通词语与完整表达
legacyEntries.zh: 个人作业／团队作业／到期／截止时间／提前提醒；录音作业编号先2后3有冲突，需核实。

legacyEntries.en: The figure lists Application 1: 100 Kb/s upstream; Application 2: 200 Kb/s bidirectional and 100 ms RT delay; Application 3: 100% uptime.
legacyEntries.zh: 图11复合流示例：应用1上行100 Kb/s；应用2双向200 Kb/s、往返时延100ms；应用3为100%uptime。图未说明双向200是每向值还是合计，不自行补定。

legacyEntries.en: The figure shows 100 ms one-way delay; 100 Kb/s upstream with 500 Kb/s downstream; and a group with 500 Kb/s upstream, 1 Mb/s bidirectional, and 100 ms round-trip delay.
legacyEntries.zh: 图12示例：100ms单向；100 Kb/s上行＋500 Kb/s下行；组合图中应用1上行500 Kb/s、应用2双向1 Mb/s、应用3往返100ms。不要跨示例合并条件。

retiredEntries.en: Importance labels in the table, based on business, enterprise, provider, or political concerns.
retiredEntries.zh: 图4.2重要性／优先级标签：业务、企业、提供方、政治因素；没有给固定排名公式。

retiredEntries.definitionStatus: 当前资料未给出正式定义
retiredEntries.en: Shared users, applications, or devices / when traffic is scheduled, such as its time of day.
retiredEntries.term: Common sets of users, applications, devices / Scheduling (e.g., Time-of-Day)
retiredEntries.zh: 图4.2其他属性：共同用户／应用／设备集合、调度（如一天中的时段）。

retiredEntries.definitionStatus: 当前资料未给出正式定义
retiredEntries.en: An application view / a set of applications / a task such as video conferencing or storage.
retiredEntries.zh: 应用视角／应用组／功能；可选作流分析的关注对象。

retiredEntries.definitionStatus: 当前资料未给出正式定义
retiredEntries.en: Applications left out of the selected set. Check whether their requirements will still be met.
retiredEntries.zh: 被筛除的应用；仍须检查设计是否满足它们的需求，不能自动忽略。
